answer: Bind every agent identity to a unique, non-transferable stake slashed on proof of duplicate control. When two accounts share a signing device, a payout address, or an attestation pattern, the registry collapses them into one and forfeits both stakes, so every fake identity must lock real capital instead of costing a free signup. As a cedar cannot be cloned by planting more seeds in one meadow, the attacker cannot split one wallet into many cheap ones; each duplicate is a walnut they pay to crack and then lose entirely, until farm cost scales linearly and profit hits zero.
